verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a Settlement Report that breaks down a single payout into all transactions, fees and deductions to help reconcile transactions. Settlement data is also reachable programmatically via the Balances API (historical balance data for bookkeeping) and a Settlements API, and refunds and chargebacks have their own APIs. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that refunds and chargebacks appear as itemized lines in the settlement report (only 'deductions' is stated), documented matching of settlements to bank deposit references, independent or hands-on corroboration.
